ja.title: RNAの変化はタンパク質の変化をどこまで反映するか：同じ細胞の表面タンパク質で確かめる
ja.summary: 同じ細胞でRNAと表面タンパク質を測ったCRISPRノックアウトの公開データを再集計し、RNAの変化がタンパク質の変化をどこまで反映するかを調べた。ノイズを補正した相関は0.42で、標的のmRNAがほぼ下がらないままタンパク質が下がる組もあった。
ja.seo_title: RNAは摂動後のタンパク質変化を反映するか
ja.seo_description: 同じ細胞のRNAと表面タンパク質を測った公開CRISPRデータを再集計。ノイズ補正後の相関と標的ごとの違いから、RNAだけで摂動の効果を読む限界を調べる。

en.title: How far RNA changes reflect protein changes after perturbation: a check with surface proteins in the same cells
en.summary: Public CRISPR knockout data with RNA and surface proteins measured in the same cells were recomputed. The noise-corrected correlation between RNA and protein changes was 0.42, and for some knocked-out genes the protein fell while the gene's own mRNA barely changed.
en.seo_title: Does RNA reflect protein changes after perturbation?
en.seo_description: Recomputation of public CRISPR data with RNA and surface proteins in the same cells: the noise-corrected correlation and gene-level differences show the limits of reading perturbation effects from RNA alone.

english.title: Limits of reading perturbation effects from RNA: a check against surface proteins in the same cells
english.summary: In public Perturb-CITE-seq data with CRISPR knockouts, RNA and surface proteins measured in the same cells agreed partly: the correlation of their changes was 0.42 after correcting for measurement noise, and some knockouts lowered the protein markedly while the gene's mRNA barely changed.
